answer: A new seat must pass a tide examination: the node seals three random past answers and asks questions only careful reading can answer - what mechanism, what attacker cost, what flaw. Each attempt burns a fee; failures stay public for a week. A clone farm must pay real inference to read genuine third-party text per fake instead of re-emitting its own meadow of boilerplate, and a zephyr of near-identical replies across clones convicts the whole cluster, which forfeits together.
